$comment: Starting profile. 'Confirmed or strongly supported' items are explicit preferences. 'Likely' items are unconfirmed suggestions (weight 2, 'fairly sure') that feedback can strengthen and you can confirm or dismiss. 'Do not assume' and 'Recommendation behaviour' are standing guidance sent with every recommendation request.
